messages.subject: Gheatmap tiplab
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I want to remove the tip label on a gheatmap object. I can do it on a heatmap, and on a tree separately, but not together.

Could you help advise please ?

Lucy
messages.body_snippet:

messages.subject: Re: Gheatmap tiplab
messages.body_plain:
gheatmap never draws tip labels. If the tree is visualization with tip labels then the final figure have the tip labels and otherwise, the tip labels will never show.

gheatmap never draws tip labels. If the tree is visualization with tip labels then the final figure have the tip labels and otherwise, the tip labels will never show.
